problems.title: Design Infinite Queue with GetRandom O(1)

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: plain list with removal from the front and direct indexing
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: growable array plus a head index (slots before the head are dead and compacted when they reach half the array); getRandom indexes head + r mod size
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(1) amortized per call/O(live elements) space

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: apply each transformation eagerly to a copied array and search it linearly
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: compose all transformations into one affine map a x + b; indexOf inverts it ((target - b) / a when divisible) and looks the preimage up in a first-index hash map; a = 0 means every element maps to b
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(n) construction, O(1) per map and indexOf/O(n) space
